title: Night of the Ninjas
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet real ninjas in old Japan and learn to follow nature — 杰克和安妮在古代日本遇见真正的忍者，学会了跟随自然！🌳

q.en: What is the name Annie gives to the little mouse in the tree house?
q.zh: 安妮给树屋里那只小老鼠起了什么名字？

explain.en: Annie pats the tiny brown-and-white mouse and says, 'Hi, Peanut,' asking if she can call it that.
explain.zh: 安妮拍拍那只棕白相间的小老鼠说：'你好，花生'，问能不能这么叫它。

q.en: What country do Jack and Annie visit in this adventure?
q.zh: 这次冒险中，杰克和安妮去的是哪个国家？

options.en: Korea, a land of high mountains
options.zh: 朝鲜/韩国，多高山的国家

explain.en: Jack reads that ninjas lived in Japan between the 14th and 17th centuries, and they land among white-flowered trees on a mountain in Japan.
explain.zh: 杰克读到忍者生活在14到17世纪的日本，而他们降落在日本一座开白花的山上。

q.en: What surprising fact does the ninja master reveal about the short ninja?
q.zh: 忍者大师透露了关于那个矮忍者的什么惊人事实？

explain.en: The master says, 'You gave the message to her,' and the short ninja's eyes sparkle — the 'short ninja' is actually a woman.
explain.zh: 大师说'你把这消息给了她'，矮忍者眼中闪着光——原来'矮忍者'是个女人。

q.en: What three rules does the ninja master tell Jack and Annie to remember?
q.zh: 忍者大师让杰克和安妮记住哪三条法则？

options.en: Run fast, hide well, and fight with all your might
options.zh: 快快跑、好好躲、使出全力战斗

options.en: Use nature, be nature, follow nature
options.zh: 运用自然、成为自然、跟随自然

explain.en: The master says, 'Remember three things: Use nature. Be nature. Follow nature.'
explain.zh: 大师说：'记住三件事：运用自然、成为自然、跟随自然。'

q.en: How do Jack and Annie figure out which way is east?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮是怎么判断哪边是东的？

options.en: By watching the stars move across the night sky
options.zh: 看着星星在夜空中移动

options.en: By the shadow of a stick in the moonlight
options.zh: 借着月光下木棍的影子

explain.en: Jack remembers a camping tip: push a stick into the ground; if its shadow is more than six inches, the shadow points east.
explain.zh: 杰克想起露营书里的方法：把木棍插进土里，如果影子超过六英寸，影子就指向东方。

q.en: What does the ninja master give Jack before they go home?
q.zh: 在回家之前，忍者大师给了杰克什么？

options.en: A small round stone called a moonstone
options.zh: 一块叫月光石的小圆石

options.en: A shiny sword with a golden handle and a jewel
options.zh: 一把镶着宝石、带金色剑柄的闪亮宝剑

explain.en: The master hands Jack 'a small, round stone' and says, 'This moonstone will help you find your missing friend.'
explain.zh: 大师递给杰克'一块小圆石'，说：'这块月光石会帮你找到失踪的朋友。'

q.en: Who are the enemies with torches and bamboo armor that chase the children?
q.zh: 举着火把、穿竹甲追孩子的敌人是谁？

explain.en: The master says his family is at war with the samurai, who wear bamboo armor and carry two swords, and will show no mercy.
explain.zh: 大师说他们家族正与武士交战，武士穿竹甲、佩双刀，而且绝不留情。

q.en: How does Peanut help Jack and Annie cross the wild stream?
q.zh: 花生是怎样帮杰克和安妮渡过湍急溪流的？

options.en: She leads them to a fallen branch bridge
options.zh: 她把他们引到一根倒下的树枝桥

options.en: She carries them safely on her tiny back
options.zh: 她把他们稳稳地背在小小的背上

explain.en: Peanut scampers along the stream to a moonlit branch fallen across it; the children 'walk the branch' like mice to cross.
explain.zh: 花生沿着溪流跑到一根横在水面的、被月光照亮的树枝旁；孩子们像老鼠一样'走树枝'过了河。

q.en: What do Jack and Annie pretend to be so they can cross the tiny branch?
q.zh: 为了走过那根细小的树枝，杰克和安妮假装自己是什么？

explain.en: Annie says, 'If you could be a rock, you can be a mouse' — they say 'squeak' and dart across the branch like Peanut.
explain.zh: 安妮说'你能当石头，也能当老鼠'——他们学着'吱吱'叫，像花生一样飞快地窜过树枝。

q.en: How many special things must Jack and Annie find to free Morgan from her spell?
q.zh: 为了解除摩根身上的魔咒，杰克和安妮必须找齐几件特别的东西？

explain.en: Morgan's note hints at 'four things,' and after Japan Jack says, 'I guess we have one of the four things' — the moonstone.
explain.zh: 摩根的纸条暗示要找'四件东西'，从日本回来后杰克说'我们大概已经有了四件中的一件'——就是月光石。
